# ToolRank: full rankings

Last updated 2026-10-15. Source: https://toolrank.io/. Editorial ranking; position 1 = top pick. Pricing labels: free / freemium / paid (as listed; verify with vendor).


## Best for vibe coding

Describe an app in plain English, get a working app.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/vibe-coding/

1. Lovable (freemium): Prompt-to-full-stack web app builder aimed at non-developers. https://lovable.dev
2. Bolt.new (freemium): Builds and runs full-stack apps in the browser from a prompt. https://bolt.new
3. v0 (freemium): Vercel's generator for React/Next.js UIs and apps, deploys to Vercel. https://v0.app
4. Replit (freemium): Replit Agent builds, hosts and deploys apps from one cloud workspace. https://replit.com

## Best coding assistants

AI pair programmers for working developers.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/coding-assistants/

1. Cursor (freemium): AI-native code editor with strong agent mode and codebase context. https://www.cursor.com
2. Claude Code (paid): Anthropic's terminal-based agentic coding tool. https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code
3. GitHub Copilot (freemium): Most widely integrated assistant across IDEs and GitHub. https://github.com/features/copilot
4. OpenAI Codex (paid): OpenAI's coding agent across CLI, IDE and cloud. https://openai.com/codex
5. Windsurf (freemium): Agentic IDE alternative to Cursor. https://windsurf.com

## Best for video

Generate and edit video with AI.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/video/

1. Runway (freemium): Pro-grade generative video models and editing tools. https://runwayml.com
2. Google Veo (paid): Google DeepMind's video model with native audio. https://deepmind.google/models/veo/
3. Kling AI (freemium): High-quality text/image-to-video from Kuaishou. https://klingai.com
4. Luma AI (freemium): Dream Machine video generation, fast and cinematic. https://lumalabs.ai
5. HeyGen (freemium): AI avatar and talking-head video, translation and dubbing. https://www.heygen.com
6. Sora (freemium): OpenAI's video generation model and app. https://openai.com/sora

## Best agent builder

Build AI agents and multi-step workflows.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/agent-builders/

1. n8n (freemium): Fair-code workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-hostable. https://n8n.io
2. LangGraph (freemium): Developer framework for stateful, controllable agents. https://www.langchain.com/langgraph
3. CrewAI (freemium): Multi-agent orchestration framework plus hosted platform. https://www.crewai.com
4. Relevance AI (freemium): No-code platform for building AI agent teams. https://www.relevanceai.com
5. Gumloop (freemium): Drag-and-drop AI automation and agent builder. https://www.gumloop.com

## Best for image generation

Create and edit images from prompts.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/image/

1. Midjourney (paid): Benchmark for aesthetic, artistic image quality. https://www.midjourney.com
2. Ideogram (freemium): Standout at legible text inside images. https://ideogram.ai
3. Black Forest Labs (FLUX) (freemium): FLUX models: top open and API image generation. https://bfl.ai
4. Recraft (freemium): Design-focused: vectors, icons, brand-consistent styles. https://www.recraft.ai
5. Krea (freemium): Real-time generation and access to many models in one place. https://www.krea.ai

## Best for writing

Drafting, editing and long-form writing.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/writing/

1. Claude (freemium): Strong long-form writing quality and natural tone. https://claude.ai
2. ChatGPT (freemium): Most versatile general assistant for drafting. https://chatgpt.com
3. Grammarly (freemium): Editing and tone help everywhere you type. https://www.grammarly.com
4. Sudowrite (paid): Purpose-built for fiction writers. https://sudowrite.com
5. Jasper (paid): Marketing content with brand voice controls for teams. https://www.jasper.ai

## Best for research & search

Answer engines and research assistants.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/research/

1. Perplexity (freemium): Cited answer engine for fast web research. https://www.perplexity.ai
2. NotebookLM (freemium): Grounded Q&A and audio overviews over your own sources. https://notebooklm.google
3. Elicit (freemium): Searches and extracts data from academic papers. https://elicit.com
4. Consensus (freemium): Evidence-based answers from peer-reviewed research. https://consensus.app

## Best for voice & audio

Speech, voice cloning, music and audio editing.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/voice-audio/

1. ElevenLabs (freemium): Leading realistic TTS, voice cloning and dubbing. https://elevenlabs.io
2. Suno (freemium): Full songs with vocals from a text prompt. https://suno.com
3. Udio (freemium): AI music generation alternative to Suno. https://www.udio.com
4. Descript (freemium): Edit audio/video by editing the transcript. https://www.descript.com
5. Wispr Flow (freemium): Voice dictation that works across apps. https://wisprflow.ai

## Best for productivity & automation

Automate work and get more done.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/productivity/

1. Zapier (freemium): Huge app catalogue with AI steps and agents. https://zapier.com
2. Make (freemium): Visual automation scenarios with AI modules. https://www.make.com
3. Notion AI (paid): AI built into docs, wikis and notes. https://www.notion.com/product/ai
4. Gamma (freemium): Generates presentations, docs and sites from a prompt. https://gamma.app
